title: ID0456678-DC/Si-D/FI-[MP / P8 170000824] Multiple issues
description:
Reported behavior/issue :
Customer reported unreliable charging with one of the chargers (acno33). We detected 4 issues. Pictures also in the attachments.
1. In past 4 weeks there has been 32 Cable temperature difference errors. Asking permission to change cable.
2. One of the Power converter has been missing thousands of time in past 4 weeks.
Asking permission to change it also.
3. The OCPP has been Offline 227 times in past 4 weeks. Is there something we could do remotely or how should we proceed.
4. Power meter errors. Is these something we should be worried about.

additional_info.body:
1. Check DC4 PT1000s and replace if necessary
2. Replace converter most likely
3. Check OCPP via SSH, Finland chargers are always by wired, don't use the SIM network
4. ReversedVoltage=true -> there hasn't been many, seems like a particular EV issue, can by the BYD problem.
